summary: Provision audited query-gateway access for retention compliance review (aggregated inference logs)
description: Request from Compliance to run a narrow suite of audited queries against aggregated inference logs to validate data retention adherence and TTL enforcement. This ticket tracks the approval, gating controls, and technical steps to enable timeboxed, read-only access via the Query Gateway with enforced query templates and automated audit logging.
request_details: Compliance (internal audit team) requests access for a 48-hour window to run three parameterized queries over the inference logs to confirm: 1) TTLs are being respected for session payloads older than 180 days; 2) duplicate retention exceptions are not present; 3) redaction markers were applied for GDPR-flagged accounts. They do NOT require raw full-payload exports — only aggregated counts/samples with hashed identifiers using an HMAC salt managed by Secrets service.
justification: Regulatory evidence request for retention policy attestation tied to an upcoming external audit. The scope is limited and timebound; risk is medium without additional controls because logs can contain customer request/response snippets if mishandled.
access_scope: Read-only access to the Query Gateway UI and API restricted to a whitelist of 3 Compliance engineers. Queries must use approved templates (no free-text ad-hoc SQL), results limited to aggregated counts and 100 anonymized samples per query. No raw inference payloads or unredacted sessions to be exported.
controls_and_mitigation: 1) Temporary role 'audited-queryer' created with minimal RBAC; 2) Query Gateway enforces template parameterization and rejects free-text; 3) All results written to an S3 'audit-staging' bucket with server-side encryption and KMS key with limited access; 4) Comprehensive audit trail enabled (who/when/query text, results hash); 5) Live monitoring by SRE with alerting on large result sizes (>10k rows) or attempts to bypass templates.
investigation_notes: Security reviewed templates and confirmed no template returns raw full-session payloads. SRE compared sample run on staging to validate performance and ensured rate limits prevent scanning. Identified a template that previously returned unredacted partial outputs for legacy logs — template updated to use 'redaction_marker' filter. Related historical ticket INT-701233 referenced for retention TTL bug; however this request is scoped to verification only.
technical_steps: 1) Create IAM role and attach 'audited-queryer' policy; 2) Add 3 compliance user principals to whitelist; 3) Load approved query templates into Query Gateway config and enable template enforcement flag; 4) Provision audit-staging S3 location and create KMS grant for the role; 5) Run dry-run in staging, then enable in prod for the 48-hour window; 6) Run automated cleanup to revoke role and delete temporary KMS grant at window end.
comments: Maya Chen (Reporter) 2026-03-10: Submitted initial request from Compliance. Provided proposed query templates and example parameters. Asked for minimal access/no raw exports.

Priya Narang (Security) 2026-03-10: Reviewed templates; flagged one template that referenced 'raw_payload' field — requested update to use 'redaction_marker' and sample hashing. Also requested KMS-wrapped results storage.

Diego Alvarez (Assignee/SRE) 2026-03-11: Implemented 'audited-queryer' role and created whitelist; ran staging dry-run and observed expected aggregated outputs. Attached staging run logs to PRs. Noted that rate limiter needed a small increase for the query window to avoid timeouts for complex aggregation.

Jonas Reed (SRE) 2026-03-11: Enabled additional monitoring and set alert thresholds. Confirmed automation to revoke role post-window. Suggested 24-hour rotation of the HMAC salt but agreed KMS grant will be timebound for now.
Priya Narang (Security) 2026-03-12: Performed final review, OK to proceed provided audit-staging S3 ACLs are validated and that Compliance signs attestation acknowledging limits.
Compliance Team Lead - Aaron Patel 2026-03-12: Signed the attestation and confirmed the analyst list. Confirmed target window works for audit scheduling.

Diego Alvarez (Assignee) 2026-03-12: Provisioned prod role and scheduled the window. Post-action: revoked role and removed KMS grant; uploaded audit trail to Compliance Evidence folder. Marking ticket as Resolved.
resolution: Access provisioned for 48 hours with enforced template-only queries, results stored encrypted in audit-staging S3, and audit trail captured. All temporary credentials and KMS grants revoked at window end. Compliance uploaded signed evidence to internal Confluence and confirmed no anomalies. Follow-up: verify rotation of HMAC salt and consider RBAC automation for future audits (action item assigned to Security team).
